# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- import dataiku import pandas as pd, numpy as np from dataiku import pandasutils as pdu from dataiku.scenario import Scenario over_budget_notifications = dataiku.Dataset("over_budget_notifications") try: over_budget_notifications_df = over_budget_notifications.get_dataframe() except: # dataset is empty, nothing to do. return for index, row in over_budget_notifications_df.iterrows(): if not row["mailNotificationSent"]: project_key = row["projectKey"] budget_usd = row["budgetUSD"] over_budget_usd = row["overBudgetUSD"] operational_manager = row["operationalManager"] project_owner = row["projectOwner"] project_owner_mail_content = f""" Hello {project_owner},

The project {project_key} is over budget.
Amount over budget {over_budget_usd} USD
Budget allocated {budget_usd} USD
Your IT contact point is {operational_manager}.

Best regards,
Dataiku LLM Cost Guard """ operational_manager_mail_content = f""" Hello dear user,

The project {project_key} you are overseeing is over budget.
Amount over budget {row['overBudgetUSD']} USD
Budget allocated {row['budgetUSD']} USD
The product manager is {row['productManager']}.

Best regards,
Dataiku LLM Cost Guard """ # keep track of notifications already sent. if over_budget_notifications_df is not None: for index, row in over_budget_notifications_df.iterrows(): project_key = row["projectKey"] over_budget_df.loc[over_budget_df["projectKey"] == project_key, "mailNotificationSent"] = row["mailNotificationSent"] over_budget_notifications.write_with_schema(over_budget_df)
